text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! That was delicious! Now then,
what does
my total come up to?

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
What did you say?! A slipped disk?! You
can't
work with a slipped disk! We need
to get you an
ambulance!

text_block_list.name: Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm totally good to go! And I can't take
a break
now! It's the lunchtime delivery
rush!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, this shop is in a tight spot!
Perhaps I could
be of assistance?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
So the first address for delivery is...
here.
If I
really get a sprint on, then—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but I'm carrying this wooden
delivery box... I'll need great balance!
And I'd better choose an
efficient route
so the noodles don't get soggy...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey! What are you doing standing
there? You're
in the way.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
So that's long and short of it... Would
you mind
lending me a hand with that
big brain of yours?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You want me to navigate a route
for you? And to factor in the cooking
time as well as your velocity? Who the
hell would agree to something as
annoying as all that?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Well, it would be beneficial for you as
well. You
could get your hands on the
data for my speed on
each route I take.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I've seen you on the training tracks
recently.
You're always glancing at your
stopwatch and
then scribbling notes.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You're always at the track at this hour,
yet now you're here. Could it be that
you're at a dead
end? Perhaps your own
data is... insufficient?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Didn't realize the little princess
was so
observant...
All right, fine. I'll
help!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Thanks! ♪ Okay, let's crack on!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Finished! That was incredible! With your
help, it
hardly took any time at all!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, lay off the cheer, would
you? Still, given all these samples I
obtained... I got way more out of the
bargain than you did, no matter how you
slice it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I doubt that! ♪ Things worked out fine
for the
ramen store, and I learned a
great deal while I
was running.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
In fact...
I bet I can use this experience in
my
training! I can't wait for my next
race! ♪
